description: Source file implementing SOCKS connection job logic, including connection setup, state management, and timeout handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: SOCKSSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for SOCKS socket connection, including proxy server info, destination, SOCKS version, and network anonymity key.

classes.name: SOCKSConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing a SOCKS connection, including transport connection, SOCKS handshake, timeout handling, and state transitions.

methods.description: Constructor for SOCKSConnectJob, initializing connection parameters.

methods.description: Returns current load state of the connection process.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection has been established.
